subject: general
question: In August 2024, which state became the first in India to provide a Unified Pension Scheme to its employees?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Maharashtra became the first state in India to provide a Unified Pension Scheme to its employees in August 2024.
 
• The scheme aims to integrate various pension schemes into a single, unified system for better management and benefits.
 
• It covers employees from different sectors, ensuring a streamlined process for pension disbursement.
 
• The Unified Pension Scheme is expected to enhance transparency and reduce administrative overheads.
 
• The scheme is a significant step towards securing the financial future of state employees.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Unified Pension Scheme (UPS)**

 
 
• The UPS is designed to combine multiple pension schemes into a single framework.
 
• It aims to provide a consistent and reliable pension system for government employees.
 
• This scheme is expected to simplify the pension management process and ensure timely disbursements.
 
 
 
• **Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA)**
 
 
• PFRDA is the regulatory body for pension schemes in India.
 
• It aims to promote old age income security by establishing, developing, and regulating pension funds.
 
 
 
• **National Pension System (NPS)**
 
 
• NPS is a voluntary, defined contribution retirement savings scheme designed to enable systematic savings during the working life of individuals.
 
• It is regulated by PFRDA and provides retirement income to citizens.
 
 
 
• **Employee Provident Fund (EPF)**
 
 
• EPF is a savings scheme for employees, providing retirement benefits.
 
• Employees contribute a portion of their salary towards the fund, with a matching contribution from the employer.
 
 
 
• **Gratuity**
 
 
• Gratuity is a lump sum payment made to employees as a token of gratitude for their service.
 
• It is typically paid upon retirement or resignation after a certain period of service.
